name: Pompei (Italy)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pompei (a cross and a star above the sea, a hand and columns).
history: Municipal flag of Pompei, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Pompei arms — cross and star above the sea, a hand and columns, crowned
